test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The telephone was invented by Graham Bell in the second half of the 18th Century.

options.text: Graham Bell will have invented the telephone in the second half of the 18th Century.
Graham Bell has invented the telephone in the second half of the 18th Century.
Graham Bell invented the telephone in the second half of the 18th Century.
Graham Bell invents the telephone in the second half of the 18th Century.

solution:
```html
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Graham Bell invented the telephone in the second half of the 18th Century."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the subject "Graham Bell" at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form "was invented" to "invented" (simple past active).
 
• Ensure the object "the telephone" and the time phrase "in the second half of the 18th Century" remain in the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Graham Bell invented the telephone in the second half of the 18th Century."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Graham Bell will have invented the telephone in the second half of the 18th Century." – Incorrect tense (future perfect).
 
• **Option 2: **"Graham Bell has invented the telephone in the second half of the 18th Century." – Incorrect tense (present perfect).
 
• **Option 4: **"Graham Bell invents the telephone in the second half of the 18th Century." – Incorrect tense (simple present).

``
